sanctuary_01.title: A Gentle Mercy
sanctuary_01.text: A woman kneels before a white mask. ‘The Veilbound saved us. They took the pain away.’

sanctuary_02.title: The Missing Face
sanctuary_02.text: A scratched confession: ‘They called it mercy when they removed my daughter’s face from my mind.’

seren_warning.title: A Voice Like Mine
seren_warning.text: A recording in Seren’s own voice: ‘If you wake, do not remember.’

ashen_01.title: Red Flowers
ashen_01.text: I remember these flowers before the Veil. Another voice insists they grew only after everyone died.

ashen_02.title: A Door Left Open
ashen_02.text: Someone returned to this house every night. No one inside remembered who they were.

choir_01.title: The Last Shift
choir_01.text: The machinery kept turning after the workers forgot what it was built to make.

echo_secret.title: The Second Seren
echo_secret.text: A child stands beside the Heartwell. She turns toward you and says, ‘You are late.’

bellkeeper.title: Command Seven
bellkeeper.text: Ring until evacuation is complete. No counter-order received. The command is centuries old.

mother_thren.title: The Cradle Number
mother_thren.text: A registry lists three hundred and twelve children evacuated from Ashen Hollow. Mother Thren's name appears under 'volunteers'. The next page insists there were no children in the district.

archive_01.title: The Redaction Room
archive_01.text: A Veilbound clerk whispers: 'We do not erase the memory. We remove the part that teaches it how to hurt.' Someone off-screen asks what remains of a person after that.

archive_02.title: The King's Two Orders
archive_02.text: Two royal seals carry the same date. One commands the Opening. The other orders every seal destroyed. Both signatures are authentic.

regent_echo.title: A Familiar Voice
regent_echo.text: The Pale Regent removes his crown. For one impossible instant, he speaks in the voice Seren remembers as her father's: 'I rebuilt myself from what you refused to keep.'
